config.design: Freeze H691 seed11 dictionary, coordinate encoder and memberships. Fit linear or even quadratic-energy gate network from scratch via hard-forward straight-through reconstruction plus group count, without gate labels. Variable-count threshold gates. Select every100steps on independent singleton/pair validation objective, test higher-order combinations only afterward. Three gate seeds.
config.limitations: Conditional gate discovery, not joint unsupervised dictionary/group discovery. Different gate parameter counts. Same teacher reused. No hierarchy or LLM validation yet.
